products.name: Machine Stretch Film
products.subtitle: Engineered for high-speed automatic wrapping machines with superior stretch & cling
products.description: Our high-performance Machine Stretch Film is manufactured using advanced multi-layer cast and blown extrusion technology. It provides exceptional load-holding force, up to 300% elongation, and high puncture resistance for pallet transit.

products.name: Hand Stretch Film
products.subtitle: Easy to use for manual wrapping applications. Strong, durable & reliable.
products.description: Premium grade manual hand stretch film roll designed for lightweight handling without sacrificing tension or load containment. Features ergonomic core rolls and silent unwind.

products.name: Mini Stretch Film (Bundle Wrap)
products.subtitle: Compact size for small loads, cable bundling and easy handling.
products.description: Narrow width stretch film ideal for bundling pipes, profiles, cartons, cables, and hardware without sticky adhesive residue.

products.name: Pre-Stretch Film
products.subtitle: High performance film with excellent stretchability and cost efficiency.
products.description: Pre-stretched during production to reduce manual operator fatigue and save up to 50% on plastic consumption while providing rigid pallet locking.

products.name: LDPE Shrink Film
products.subtitle: Heavy-duty secondary packaging for beverage multipacks, cans, and bulk containers.
products.description: High tensile strength LDPE shrink film engineered for heat tunnels. Provides tight crystal-clear bundle containment for bottled water, soda cans, and jars.

products.name: Bopp Laminated Rolls & Pouches
products.subtitle: High-barrier printed multi-layer laminated film rolls for food, spice, and retail packaging.
products.description: Printed on our state-of-the-art 600m/min rotogravure printing machine. Offers moisture barrier, aroma preservation, and vivid photo-realistic branding.

products.name: Agri Packaging & Silage Stretch Film
products.subtitle: UV-stabilized agricultural films for silage bales, mulch beds, and greenhouse covers.
products.description: Engineered for Indian and global farming conditions with multi-layer co-extrusion. Includes black/silver mulch films, green silage stretch wraps for hay preservation, and solarization films.

products.name: Pharma & Industrial Garbage Bags
products.subtitle: Puncture-proof, leak-resistant biohazard and industrial heavy-duty waste collection rolls.
products.description: Heavy duty Star-sealed bottom rolls available in clinical colors (Black, Blue, Yellow, Red) for hospital biomedical management and warehouse hygiene.

gallery.title: Multi-Layer Film Extrusion Plant
gallery.description: Towering multi-story high-speed blown film co-extrusion line producing ultra-consistent gauge stretch and barrier films.

gallery.title: High-Speed Rotogravure Printing Press
gallery.description: 600 m/min multi-color rotogravure printing line delivering photorealistic graphic accuracy for BOPP and laminated rolls.

gallery.title: Laminated Rolls & Pouches Showroom
gallery.description: Comprehensive display of finished pouches, standing zip pouches, and printed packaging for food, agriculture & retail.

gallery.title: Automated Pallet Wrapping In Action
gallery.description: Heavy industrial pallet wrapped flawlessly with SMS Enterprises high-tensile stretch film on turntable wrapper.

gallery.title: Industrial Pallet Logistics Ready for Transit
gallery.description: Secure multi-stack carton shipment wrapped with high load-holding film for zero damage transportation.

gallery.title: Agricultural Silage & Mulch Solutions
gallery.description: UV-stabilized silage stretch wrapping bales stacked on farm field with black mulch bed roll.
